cases.title: mock-idp renderLoginPage renders single login button, not persona picker
steps: Trigger renderLoginPage() by sending GET authorize request without action or persona
cases.expected: Page contains exactly one <a> button labelled 'Đăng nhập với App Nhà Phố'; no persona picker (no radio buttons, no select, no multiple persona options)
cases.actual: renderLoginPage() (lines 47-92) returns HTML with a single <a class='btn'> element. The href is built with persona=test hardcoded in qs array (line 57). No other persona selection UI elements exist in the HTML. PASS.

cases.title: Clicking login button auto-logins with persona=test
cases.expected: Request goes to same endpoint with persona=test and action=login in query string, triggering handleAuthorize to issue auth code for test persona
cases.actual: The button href (line 84: href='?${qs}') includes persona=test and action=login (qs array lines 50-58). handleAuthorize() at line 99: condition (action === 'login' || (persona && !action)) && persona evaluates to true when action=login and persona=test. PERSONAS['test'] exists (line 37). Auth code is issued. PASS.

cases.title: PERSONAS.test has all 5 required fields
cases.expected: Fields present: sub, name, role, tenant, level — all non-empty strings
cases.actual: Line 37: test: { sub: 'user_test_001', name: 'Tài khoản Test', role: 'hoc_vien', tenant: 'nhapho', level: 'beginner' }. All 5 fields present and non-empty. PASS.

cases.title: auth-widget logged-out renders login button pointing to /api/auth/login
steps: initAuthWidget() called with /api/auth/me returning 401 or { authenticated: false }
cases.actual: renderLoggedOut() line 54: loginHref = '/api/auth/login?returnTo=' + encodeURIComponent(location.href). This is '/api/auth/login', not '/login.html'. PASS.

cases.title: auth-widget logged-in state shows name only, no role badge
preconditions: /api/auth/me returns { authenticated: true, user: { name: 'Tài khoản Test', role: 'hoc_vien' } }
cases.expected: Widget shows Tài khoản Test and Đăng xuất. No role badge element.
cases.actual: renderLoggedIn() lines 44-50: renders only .aw-name (user.name) and .aw-logout. No role badge element, no mention of ROLE_LABELS, no role display. NOTE: ROLE_LABELS is defined at line 18 and roleLabel() function at lines 35-41, but they are NEVER called by renderLoggedIn() or renderLoggedOut(). These are dead code. PASS for spec requirement (no badge shown). Dead code is a maintenance concern (defect DEF-A-001 below).

cases.title: auth-widget degrades gracefully when /api/auth/me is unreachable
steps: initAuthWidget() called with network request throwing
cases.expected: Catch block handles the error, falls through to renderLoggedOut()
cases.actual: Lines 103-106: catch (_e) block is present and silences the error. Lines 108-109: _cachedUser = null; renderLoggedOut(containerEl); called unconditionally after try-catch. PASS.

cases.title: auth-widget degrades gracefully when containerEl is null
cases.actual: Line 87: if (!containerEl) return; Guard is first line of function. PASS.

cases.title: auth-widget escapes user.name before injecting into DOM
preconditions: API returns user.name containing HTML characters
cases.expected: Name is HTML-escaped; no script executes
cases.actual: renderLoggedIn() line 47: ${escAttr(user.name || 'Tài khoản')}. escAttr() (lines 62-70) replaces &, <, >, ", ' with HTML entities. PASS.

cases.title: index.html auth widget mount: import failure does not crash the page
cases.expected: Remaining page content (modules, search, etc.) loads normally; widget mount is empty
cases.actual: index.html lines 784-789: dynamic import wrapped in try-catch with empty catch block. Page boot() is called separately via DOMContentLoaded listener (line 781) — it does not depend on auth widget. PASS.

cases.title: mock-idp authorize: unknown persona returns 400
cases.actual: handleAuthorize() line 101: if (!user) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'unknown_persona' }). PERSONAS['fake_persona'] is undefined. PASS.
